question: Within 90 kilometers, where can I find a restaurant ahead of Funkmeyer New Reality Garden, Los Angeles, CA toward Drought Tolerant Garden, Glendora, CA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-118.366951 34.039786)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-117.837227 34.146743)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'restaurant'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-118.366951 34.039786)',4326)::geography, 90000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-118.366951 34.039786)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
